positions.title: O le Ao o le Malo

officials.summary: Malietoa Tanumafili II (4 January 1913 – 11 May 2007) was O le Ao o le Malo (head of state) of Samoa from its independence in 1962 until his death in 2007. He was bestowed with the Malietoa title in 1940 and had previously worked for the New Zealand administration as a civil servant and parliamentarian.

officials.summary: Tui Ātua Tupua Tamasese Tupuola Tufuga Efi (born 1 March 1938) is a Samoan paramount chief, politician and statesman who served as prime minister of Samoa from 1976 to 1982, and as O le Ao o le Malo (head of state) of Samoa from 2007 to 2017. He is currently a member of the Council of Deputies, having previously sat on the council from 2004 to 2007.

officials.summary: Tui Ātua Tupua Tamasese Lealofi IV (8 May 1922 – 9 July 1983) was the second prime minister of Samoa from 25 February 1970 to 20 March 1973 and again from 21 May 1975 to 24 March 1976. He held the title of Tupua Tamasese, one of the four main chiefly titles of Samoa (the Tama-a-Aiga) from 1965 until his death in 1983.
